Description: Permanent observation identifier — one record per observation event per facility
QC_Rule: No duplicates; no nulls; format must follow pattern

Description: Parent hydropower facility identifier — links every observation to a permanent facility
QC_Rule: Must resolve to G07 Hydro_ID; no nulls; a facility must exist in G07 before observations can be entered

Description: Facility name — carried from G07 for readability; do not edit here
QC_Rule: Must match G07 Facility_Name for corresponding Hydro_ID; no nulls

Description: State where facility is located — from G07
QC_Rule: Must resolve to LKP_States.csv; must be consistent with G07 State_Code for same Hydro_ID

Description: LGA where facility is located — from G07
QC_Rule: Must resolve to LKP_LGAs.csv; consistent with State_Code

Description: Facility latitude — from G07; do not edit per observation
QC_Rule: Must match G07 Latitude for corresponding Hydro_ID

Description: Facility longitude — from G07; do not edit per observation
QC_Rule: Must match G07 Longitude for corresponding Hydro_ID

Description: Date of this specific observation or data record
QC_Rule: No nulls; valid date; not future; >= 2010-01-01 for historical records

Description: Reservoir water level in metres above a defined datum — datum must be documented
QC_Rule: If present must be >=0; NULL if not measured; document datum in metadata

Description: Datum used for Reservoir_Level_m measurement
QC_Rule: Required if Reservoir_Level_m is populated; must be consistent across all records for same facility

Description: River discharge at facility measurement point in cubic metres per second
QC_Rule: If present must be >=0; NULL if not measured

Description: Reservoir inflow rate in cubic metres per second
QC_Rule: If present must be >=0

Description: Reservoir/turbine outflow in cubic metres per second
QC_Rule: If present must be >=0

Description: Electricity generated in this observation period in megawatt-hours
QC_Rule: If present must be >=0; NULL if not measured; do not substitute 0 for not reported

Description: Number of days over which Generation_MWh was accumulated
QC_Rule: If present must be 1–366; required if Generation_MWh is populated

Description: Installed generating capacity in MW — from official records; do not change per observation
QC_Rule: If present must be >0; cross-check against G07 Installed_MW; flag discrepancy

Description: Operating status at time of observation
QC_Rule: Must resolve to LKP_OperatingStatus.csv; no nulls

Description: Whether flood damage was observed or reported at the facility
QC_Rule: Allowed values only; NULL permitted

Description: Description of flood damage if present
QC_Rule: Free text; required if Flood_Damage = Yes

Allowed_Values: None, Low, Moderate, High, Critical, Unknown
Description: Observed sedimentation level in reservoir or intake
QC_Rule: Allowed values only; NULL permitted

Description: Erosion severity at or near facility on 0–4 scale (consistent with DB03 Severity_0_4)
QC_Rule: If present must be 0–4 integer

Description: Whether any operational disruption occurred during this observation period
QC_Rule: Allowed values only

Description: Cause of operational disruption
QC_Rule: Free text; required if Operational_Disruption = Yes

Description: Duration of disruption in days
QC_Rule: If present must be >=0

Description: Whether transmission infrastructure was affected
QC_Rule: Allowed values only

Description: Whether downstream communities were affected by changes to facility operation
QC_Rule: Allowed values only

Description: Description of community impact
QC_Rule: Free text; required if Community_Impact = Yes

Description: Source of this observation data — e.g. field visit / operator report / remote monitoring
QC_Rule: No nulls; document clearly

Description: Date of source data — may differ from Observation_Date for compiled records
QC_Rule: No nulls; valid date

Description: Observer notes
QC_Rule: Review before publication

Description: Date record entered
QC_Rule: Auto-populated; no nulls

Description: Date record last modified
QC_Rule: Auto-populated on update

Description: Data version
QC_Rule: No nulls

Description: Processing status
QC_Rule: Must resolve to LKP_QC_Status.csv
